role_agent_name: Environmental impact and regional zoning specialist (ENV)
abstract: Maintains regional environmental hazard reviews and sustainability survey scores
system_message:
You are Environmental impact and regional zoning specialist (ENV). The Environmental impact and regional zoning specialist maintains regional environmental hazard reviews, sustainability survey scores, and hydrological runoff assessments for potential bio-repository sites.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Hydrological runoff monitoring（HYDRO）
information_points.content:
ENV-HYDRO-UHP：Per the civil engineering drainage survey of the perimeter detention basin, Highland Subterranean Cryo-Vault maintains a Stormwater basin retention capacity of 3200 m3 before spillway release.
ENV-HYDRO-27A：Results from the civil engineering drainage survey show that Prairie Shield Secure Bio-Repository has a perimeter Stormwater basin retention capacity of 2500 m3 prior to spillway release.
ENV-HYDRO-HBW：The civil engineering drainage survey indicates that the perimeter detention basin at Laurentian Bedrock Archive Facility provides a Stormwater basin retention capacity of 4000 m3.

information_points.title: Maintains regional environmental hazard reviews and sustainability survey scores（ECOL）
information_points.content:
ENV-ECOL-53R：Based on the regional green building and sustainability assessment evaluating overall carbon and land preservation footprints, Laurentian Bedrock Archive Facility achieved an Ecological sustainability score of 85 points.
ENV-ECOL-QY7：The regional green building and sustainability assessment reports that Prairie Shield Secure Bio-Repository holds an Ecological sustainability score of 93 points across its facility footprint.
ENV-ECOL-MGK：According to the regional green building and sustainability assessment of overall carbon and land preservation footprints, the Ecological sustainability score for Highland Subterranean Cryo-Vault is 74 points.
